GOROUTINE SCHEDULER — M:N multiplexing
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                                                                     │
│  Goroutines (G) — lightweight, 2KB stack, thousands are normal      │
│  ┌──┐ ┌──┐ ┌──┐ ┌──┐ ┌──┐ ┌──┐ ┌──┐ ┌──┐                            │
│  │G1│ │G2│ │G3│ │G4│ │G5│ │G6│ │G7│ │G8│  ... (many)                │
│  └──┘ └──┘ └──┘ └──┘ └──┘ └──┘ └──┘ └──┘                            │
│       │           │           │           │                         │
│       └─────┬─────┘           └─────┬─────┘                         │
│             ▼                       ▼                               │
│      ┌─────────────┐         ┌─────────────┐                        │
│      │  Go runtime │         │  Go runtime │  ← work-stealing       │
│      │  scheduler  │◄───────►│  scheduler  │    scheduler           │
│      └──────┬──────┘         └──────┬──────┘                        │
│             ▼                       ▼                               │
│      ┌──────────┐             ┌──────────┐                          │
│      │ OS thread│             │ OS thread│  ← few (≈ GOMAXPROCS)    │
│      │    M1    │             │    M2    │                          │
│      └──────────┘             └──────────┘                          │
│                                                                     │
│  C# parallel: Task → ThreadPool → OS threads  (same shape!)         │
│  Key difference: goroutine startup cost ≈ 2KB vs Task ≈ 1MB+        │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

CHANNEL — typed communication pipe between goroutines
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                                                                     │
│  Goroutine A          channel ch           Goroutine B              │
│  ┌─────────┐         ┌───────────┐        ┌─────────┐               │
│  │         │ ch <- v │  [v][v][] │ <- ch  │         │               │
│  │ sender  │────────►│  buffered │───────►│receiver │               │
│  │         │         │  (cap=3)  │        │         │               │
│  └─────────┘         └───────────┘        └─────────┘               │
│                                                                     │
│  Unbuffered (cap=0): send BLOCKS until receiver is ready            │
│  Buffered (cap=N):   send blocks only when buffer is full           │
│                                                                     │
│  C# equivalent: Channel<T> from System.Threading.Channels           │
│  Key difference: Go channels can be used in select (see below)      │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

SELECT — non-deterministic channel multiplexer
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                                                                     │
│  select {                                                           │
│  case v := <-ch1:   ← ready?  ──────────────┐                       │
│  case v := <-ch2:   ← ready?  ──── pick     │ one ready case        │
│  case ch3 <- x:     ← ready?  ──── at       │ chosen at random      │
│  case <-time.After(t): timeout ──── random  │ if multiple ready     │
│  default:           ← non-blocking fallback ┘                       │
│  }                                                                  │
│                                                                     │
│  C# equivalent: Task.WhenAny(task1, task2, task3)                   │
│  Key difference: select is a first-class language keyword,          │
│  not a library call; works symmetrically for send and receive       │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

C# vs GO CONCURRENCY CONCEPTS
┌─────────────────────┬─────────────────────┬───────────────────────┐
│ C# concept          │ Go equivalent       │ Key difference        │
├─────────────────────┼─────────────────────┼───────────────────────┤
│ Task / async method │ goroutine (go func) │ Goroutine is cheaper; │
│                     │                     │ no await keyword      │
├─────────────────────┼─────────────────────┼───────────────────────┤
│ Channel<T>          │ chan T              │ Go select built-in;   │
│                     │                     │ bidirectional default │
├─────────────────────┼─────────────────────┼───────────────────────┤
│ Task.WhenAny        │ select              │ select handles sends  │
│                     │                     │ AND receives; random  │
├─────────────────────┼─────────────────────┼───────────────────────┤
│ Parallel.ForEach    │ goroutine+WaitGroup │ Manual fan-out; no    │
│                     │                     │ built-in parallelism  │
├─────────────────────┼─────────────────────┼───────────────────────┤
│ CancellationToken   │ context.Context     │ Passed explicitly as  │
│                     │                     │ first arg, convention │
└─────────────────────┴─────────────────────┴───────────────────────┘
